raw_intent:
This isn't bad, but I'm not also blown away or like, "Yes, we nailed it like the other one!" I can see it. I think there'll be some pushback from Jen on the relevance of this and the delivery. Is this actually something that would resonate with her ICP and first-time homebuyers in the San Fernando Valley? I see where you reference and grab this from, but then again, when I talked about the references, is there a reason why you keep ignoring the VidIQ MCP and not leveraging that? I think it has better data and going straight to Instagram.

Unless you're able to quickly do what you've been doing in the references that you're grabbing from, I think it might not be what I'm aiming for when it comes to real estate: finding proven real estate winners and being able to translate them and deploy them for ourselves. Again, we keep running into this issue where I don't know how to prompt you, and it feels like a lot of the core things that I've built to help with this (our global settings and steering and all that) are just not even helping me right now. I feel like I'm on an island trying to figure this out and dealing with something that's too smart for me to understand, communicate with, and get the result that I want.
